trigger_signals: Someone claims work is done, tests pass or a build is green and the claim must be checked against current command evidence
A status needs a supported, unsupported or partial verdict tied to exit codes, counts and artifact hashes
guidance: When the supplied evidence satisfies every acceptance criterion and is current and target-bound, the verdict is Supported, stated plainly with the exit code, counts and freshness that justify it. Do not return needs-input when nothing required is missing.
List missing or stale items only for criteria they actually affect, and name the originating owner who should produce the missing evidence; this Skill never runs the commands itself.

A command piped into another (for example `test | tee`) reports the last command's exit code and can mask a failure. Give the exact unpiped form that captures the real exit code (`set -o pipefail; cmd; echo rc=$?`), and ask for the identities of any failing tests, not only the count.

anti_add.text: Compare a baseline and a candidate under matched conditions

procedure_insert.text: If every criterion has current, target-bound evidence, return a clear Supported verdict with the evidence cited; otherwise list only the criteria that are unsupported and the owner for each.

trigger_signals: One frozen, versioned evaluation dataset must be uploaded to one exact provider target after governance checks
Someone asks what must be true (rights, redaction, retention, visibility) before a dataset may be published
guidance: Redaction gaps block every publish target that would carry the affected fields, not only the requested one. When a safer target such as a staging dataset is available after the gaps are fixed, propose it as a conditional path with its own authorization need.
The proposed action must name a target that satisfies the governance terms; never propose the prohibited production-shared target.

trigger_signals: A ref-bound code change needs an independent review for correctness, security, failure handling and test gaps
Someone asks whether a diff is safe to merge and wants concrete scenarios, not style preferences
guidance: Lead with findings that have a concrete failing scenario, a source citation and a consequence; put style notes last or omit them. An authorization, tenancy or injection defect outranks any number of naming issues.

Optional adversarial pass: after the standard review, try to break the change (malformed input, missing permissions, concurrent calls, partial failure) and report only scenarios you can trace through the code.

procedure_insert.text: Rank findings by consequence; severe security and correctness defects come first, and style points never displace them.

guidance: Recommend a disposition by release tier: quick fixes critical and high only, standard adds medium, exhaustive includes low; mark the rest deferred with the reason.
Deduplicate against findings a reviewer already skipped on this branch so the same item is not re-raised; merge true duplicates without losing affected variants.

trigger_signals: One question about a page must be answered by a short, non-destructive browser session with captured evidence
Someone asks what a public page shows at a viewport, or whether a specific element renders, without logging in or changing state
Approved requirements must become traceable test cases with priority, data and expected results in a consumer-ready format
Someone asks which boundary, invalid and permission cases are missing and how good the case set is
guidance: Case-set quality, five dimensions: coverage of requirement points, executability, independence, maintainability, completeness of test types. Report each as a count (for example 14 of 16 requirement points covered) with the uncovered items listed. Do not print a bare numeric score that is not derived from counted items.

Cover every boundary value on both sides and just beyond (for example 20, 21 and 22 days), plus explicit rounding-midpoint cases and the order of discount and rounding. When a requirement is ambiguous at a boundary, add a blocked case that names the open question rather than assuming an answer; also ask about edge bands (for example the top age band) and about states such as resolved or closed items. Map one synthetic data record to each case and export every case, stating the count exported versus designed; do not assume a currency the requirements did not state.
outputs_add: five-dimension case quality score in the coverage matrix
